description: Muse Music v1.0.6 introduces native YouTube Music track resolution for cloud sync, eliminating JioSaavn playback failures and ensuring instant, seamless audio streaming for all synced tracks.

changelog.title: Native YouTube Music Track Resolution
items: Eliminated JioSaavn playback failures: all cloud-synced tracks are resolved directly to 11-char YouTube Video IDs
Automatic background track resolution using YouTube Music search pipeline with verified titles and audio streams
Dual cloud backfill: resolved YouTube IDs are synced back to Firestore for instant future synchronization
Integrated rate-limit protection and in-memory LRU cache for lightning-fast playlist reconciliation
Live resolving status counter in Account Settings ('Resolving with YouTube X/Y...')

changelog.title: Cloud Sync & Playback Improvements
items: Unlinking and playlist item deletions now accurately match both document IDs and YouTube video IDs
Guaranteed instant playback on ExoPlayer for all liked songs and custom playlist imports
Enhanced Nothing OS 5.0 sync indicator card with reactive busy states and retry handling
